question: Should AXorcist distribute `axorc` through a shared OpenClaw Homebrew tap, and should the formula build from source or install release-built binaries?
rationale: The requested outcome is clear, but package ownership, artifact strategy, architecture coverage, and cross-repository release maintenance require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Shared tap with binaries
options.body: Publish checksummed supported-architecture `axorc` assets and update an OpenClaw tap formula whenever a release is tagged.

options.title: Shared source formula
options.body: Build the tagged Swift package during installation, accepting local toolchain and build-time maintenance requirements.

options.title: Defer Homebrew support
options.body: Retain the documented SwiftPM build-and-copy workflow until the release automation has a committed owner.

recommendation.title: Shared tap with binaries
recommendation.body: Publish checksummed supported-architecture `axorc` assets and update an OpenClaw tap formula whenever a release is tagged.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects steipete to AXorcist releases and Peekaboo synchronization.
